meta.title: Balance / Token usage
meta.description: Adds a Balance/Token entry at the sidebar foot and shows the DeepSeek account full usage history, the UncensoredLLM relay balance and its local token usage: balance, spend, tokens and request counts, filterable by date, API key and model; both provider balances refresh about every 2 hours.
